in_marathi.name: Shidharth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shidharth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shidharth is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shidhartha', which means 'prosperous' or 'successful'. In Hindu mythology, Shidharth is believed to be the name of a king who ruled over the Vidarbha region in ancient India. He is also known as the 'King of Hastinapura' and is a central character in the epic Mahabharata.
